title: Accidental Glass Breakage Schedule of the Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Plans
content:
Accidental glass breakage is part of Warranty Coverage only in the plans this schedule marks as covering it. Where a plan does not cover breakage, its breakage term, deductible and yearly claim allowance are all zero.

| Plan | Breakage covered | Breakage term (years) | Deductible per approved breakage claim (USD) | Approved breakage claims per rolling 365 days | Emergency board-up included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | no | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | no | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | no | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | yes | 10 | 75.00 | 1 | yes |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | yes | 20 | 50.00 | 2 | yes |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | yes | 20 | 50.00 | 2 | yes |

## What counts as accidental breakage

The same in every plan: **sudden breakage from an accidental impact; deliberate damage, storms and other acts of nature are excluded.**

## Column notes

- The breakage term is counted in years from the coverage start date.
- The deductible applies per approved glass breakage claim.
- The claim allowance is a count of approved glass breakage claims per registration in any rolling 365 days.
- Board-up means emergency board-up of the broken opening, included with an approved glass breakage claim.

## Points of reference

**A plan with breakage coverage, hypothetically eight years after the coverage start date.** The Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty (10-year term) and the two 20-year plans are all still inside the breakage term.

**Twelve years after the coverage start date.** The 10-year breakage term of the Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty has ended; the 20-year terms of the Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty and the Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty have not.
